view.noResultsWhy: Search only ever covers what this device has decrypted — the server holds ciphertext and cannot search for you. A message can be missing because:
view.reasonNotIngested: it is in a conversation you have not opened on this device yet
view.reasonBeforeJoin: it was sent before you joined that conversation
view.reasonNewDevice: it was sent before this device was added to your account
view.reasonRetention: it falls outside your local message-history window
view.reasonDeleted: it was deleted, which removes the text for good
